metadata.name: Svelte Hello World
metadata.description: Create a simple Svelte hello world application
metadata.author: user

goals.objective: Create a simple Svelte hello world application that displays a greeting message

success: Svelte project is initialized with proper structure
Application runs successfully in development mode
Page renders without errors in the browser
acceptance: Running 'npm run dev' starts the development server
Visiting the dev URL shows the hello world message

constraints: Use the official Svelte project template
Keep the implementation minimal and simple
No additional dependencies beyond the base template
